verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas ships an official Editor MCP Server that lets external AI assistants connect to a live Editor session to modify project data (scenes/scripts/assets) and verify results in the viewport, plus 'PlayCanvas Skills' that give compatible AI coding agents PlayCanvas-specific workflows — this covers scaffolding/scene manipulation and API-aware automation. However, this is an integration layer for third-party AI clients (Claude, Cursor, etc.) rather than a built-in, in-engine assistant UI for chatting/generating scripts natively. Missing for 10: evidence of a first-party embedded chat/assistant UI inside the Editor itself, and concrete examples of it answering API questions or generating scripts end-to-end.
